data_description.host: Lamps found on the network, listed by IP address and device ID. An IP address can also be typed in. If the lamp later gets a different IP address, it is found again automatically.
data_description.token: 32-character miIO token of the lamp, e.g. from Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor.

data_description.host: Current IP address of the lamp.
data_description.token: 32-character miIO token of the lamp. It changes when the lamp is reset and paired again.

error.cannot_connect: The lamp did not answer. Check the IP address and the token.
error.invalid_token: The token must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.unsupported_model: This lamp model is not supported.

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already set up.
abort.wrong_lamp: This is a different lamp than the one set up in this entry.

adjust.name: Adjust
adjust.description: Changes brightness and/or color temperature relative to the current value. The lamp computes the new value itself.

brightness_step.name: Brightness step
brightness_step.description: Change in percentage points, -100 to 100. A light that is off counts as 0 % and turns on; below 1 % it turns off.

color_temp_step.name: Color temperature step
color_temp_step.description: Change in percent of the current color temperature, -100 to 100.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Fade time in seconds. Without it the lamp's default transition is used.
